message: [condition] strategy report preview condition 'P_ALL_EDGE' holds a ALL group together on at least 2 of 3 closes, but 'custom:0b7f688e-045d-8dff-84fb-0885d958e4ca.RSI14': it reads a transition — a change that fires on one bar — so it can be held "within 194 closes" only, never on 2 or more of them.

allowedDomain.rule: a hold may count at most 194 closes and require at most 1 of them
